rationale: Pivot from qda_classifier (16 sweeps, plateaued at 1/7 best with FLAT threshold sweep — saturated posteriors disable SCORE_THRESHOLDS, so no HP can fix the over-trading). gaussian_nb's default config already shows threshold sweep biting (W2 thr=0.55, W3 thr=0.5, W6 thr=0.7, W7 thr=0.6); 210-config search space (var_smoothing 7 × pca 5 × prior_class1 6) is untouched. The factorized class-conditional likelihood is genuinely different from QDA's full-covariance discriminant and from every other registry trainer.
